items.description: One Elementor widget type name, such as heading or image-box.

widgetTypes.description: The widget type names to check, at least one and at most 100. A longer list is refused rather than shortened, so that no answer is ever missing without saying so. A name repeated in the list is answered once.

type.description: The proposed widget type name, exactly as it was asked about.

available.description: True when the Elementor installed on this site registers this widget type.

widgets.description: One entry per distinct proposed type, in the order first asked about.

unavailable.description: Only the proposed types this site does not register, so a client never has to re-derive the list. Empty when every proposed type is available.

elementorVersion.description: The Elementor version the check was made against.

registeredCount.description: How many widget types the registry holds in total. Zero means the registry was read and holds nothing, which is a different state from a registry that could not be read at all — that one refuses instead of answering.
